title: Lost and Found - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Lost and Found trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Lost and Found phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. The final reward is the Goldblaze Phantom Edge, so the trophy and a weapon sit behind the same chain.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete every one of Quick Hand's requests.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 25 of 36 on the list - before it The Healer's Legacy · after it A Tempered Ten. It is missable, and the checklist of everything that expires is on the guide. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
